# singletenant.ai

> Independent, evidence-linked reference on dedicated and single-tenant LLM hosting: which vendors offer it, where,
> on what terms, with which certifications, data residency and parent jurisdiction. Every vendor fact links to a dated
> primary source; facts that couldn't be confirmed are shown as "Not verified", not guessed. Written and maintained
> by Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic; owned by Simon Newton. No vendor pays for inclusion or placement.

## Data

- [Vendor matrix](https://singletenant.ai/vendors/): every vendor, filterable by category, jurisdiction, certification and residency evidence
- [Open data](https://singletenant.ai/data/): the whole database as CSV and JSON (CC BY 4.0), every fact with its source URL and check date
- [Compare two vendors](https://singletenant.ai/compare/): side-by-side pages generated from the same data
- [Jurisdictions](https://singletenant.ai/jurisdictions/): vendors by parent jurisdiction and where they're sovereign
- [Changelog](https://singletenant.ai/changelog/): every data change, dated, with sources

## How the data is made

- [Methodology](https://singletenant.ai/methodology/): sourcing, evidence levels (contractual vs stated), regions, sovereignty test
- [Editorial policy](https://singletenant.ai/editorial-policy/): what counts as single-tenant, check cadence, how AI is used
- [Corrections](https://singletenant.ai/corrections/): how to report an error, vendor right of reply, the corrections log
- [Disclosure](https://singletenant.ai/disclosure/): independence and monetisation policy

## Guides and analysis

- [Guides](https://singletenant.ai/guides/): provisioned throughput on Azure OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock, dedicated vs pay-per-token
- [Analysis](https://singletenant.ai/blog/): data residency vs sovereignty, the jurisdiction problem, sovereignty washing, the UK buyer's position

## Optional

- [About](https://singletenant.ai/about/): who makes the site
